english.title: Enter / remain in prohibited area on the Tyne and Wear Metro
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 13(1)(i) and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

date

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) When using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
(iv) Byelaw 31(6) provides that in relation to this byelaw: An authorised person acting in the course of his duties shall not be liable for breach of this byelaw.
(v) Byelaw 31(4) provides that no person shall be subject to any penalty for breach of any of the Byelaws by disobeying a notice unless it is proved to the satisfaction of the Court before whom the complaint is laid that the notice referred to in the particular Byelaw was displayed.
(vi) Byelaw 31(5) provides that any person who attempts to breach byelaw 13(1) shall be liable to the same penalty as for the full offence.
